**Kestrel planning, 3–10 Nov** (Maya, Jonah, Ken, Sofia, Lena)

**Final values (after corrections):** cache ttl_s 360; upload ttl_s 570, timeout_s 85; webhooks timeout_s 50; session queue_depth 50; auth retry_limit 5; catalog batch_size 200, retry_limit 8; export queue_depth 420; gateway batch_size 250; checkout timeout_s 75.

**Couplings:** catalog.retry_limit above 6 requires feed.ttl_s of at least 540. checkout.timeout_s above 65 requires gateway.timeout_s of at least 120. session.queue_depth above 40 caps reports.batch_size at 150.

**Placement:** ledger on beta; metrics, catalog, returns, export, and checkout on alpha; feed and webhooks on delta. Pricing and session share a worker, as do alerts and auth.

**Constraints:** no dependency path from metrics to catalog; auth must not depend on catalog; gateway must not depend on webhooks; ingest must not depend on pricing. Gateway must roll out before auth.

**Other:** security review and on-call rota change next month; budget review moved to next Thursday.
